sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace presence-only date checks with a cross-document consistency constraint that compares Polar certificate validity dates, survey dates, and endorsement dates against the applicable SOLAS schedule date records via hasSolasCertificateSchedule/hasCertificateScheduleDateRecord; locate the canonical schedule-record date/relationship terms required for that comparison. Also require the certificate supplement to record requiredEquipmentRecords using the canonical relationship/path, not merely supplement-present=true.
